annotation.title_clean: 关于印发《紧急采购管理暂行办法》的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Issuing the Interim Measures for the Administration of Emergency Procurement
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 财政部; 应急管理部 (Ministry of Finance; Ministry of Emergency Management)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Emergency Management notice issuing interim measures on emergency government procurement during disasters and force majeure events. It simplifies procedures and supplier qualification checks, requires records and result announcements, and sets supervision and liability rules. Effective 1 October 2026. Unrelated to AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines emergency procurement and when it may be triggered after reserves and transfers prove insufficient
Allows simplified procedures, shortened response times and direct purchase when competition is impractical
Prefers domestic goods; imports need only filing with the superior budget unit
Requires results announcement within ten working days and 15-year record retention
Sets supervision by finance and emergency departments and legal liability; effective 1 October 2026
